rows.text: You arrive at the docking bay of the Freon Mechanical Alliance. It is a vast harbor with mechanical attendants everywhere.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A mechanical attendant leads you up a staircase, which you notice is formed by numerous mechanical arms. You keep going until you leave the harbor and see the sign of "Interastral Peace Mechanical Branch Shopping Mall."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The place is renovated in a style very much iconic to the IPC... You walk up to the counter.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "We sell our stuff cheaper at the port. That's it." The mechanical staff doesn't bother to explain too much — a signal for you to make your own choice.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
